terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: Welcome to Kaamwale. By booking or offering services on our platform, you agree to these Terms and Conditions.
terms.sec1Body: Kaamwale connects customers directly with independent verified local service professionals. Booking confirmations are completed via WhatsApp or direct communication. All service agreements and final quotes are agreed upon before work commences.
terms.sec2Body: Initial budget estimates are provided during booking. The final cost may vary depending on spare parts required or extra labor requested by the customer. Payments are settled directly between the customer and service partner upon job completion.
terms.sec3Body: Customers can cancel or reschedule bookings free of charge before the service partner departs for the location. Excessive last-minute cancellations may limit platform access.
terms.sec4Body: All service professionals undergo background verification. However, customers are advised to secure personal valuables. Kaamwale assists in resolving disputes between parties in good faith.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Kaamwale, we prioritize your privacy and data security. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacy.sec1Body: We collect information provided by you during service booking, such as your selected category, timing preferences, budget, GPS coordinates, manual address, and issue description.
privacy.sec2Body: Your details are used solely to match you with a nearby verified service professional and generate your WhatsApp booking message. We do not sell or trade your personal data to third-party marketers.
privacy.sec3Body: GPS location is captured only when you explicitly click the 'Share GPS location' button to help technicians reach your destination accurately.
privacy.sec4Body: We employ strict security measures to protect your data. If you have privacy inquiries, contact us at privacy@kaamwale.example.
